name: Kirin
description: Kami who answered the orochi's appeal and helped them understand their loss of power.

description_citations.text: "Snake". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kirin answer the orochi's plea and help them learn that they must give up limbs to regain the forest kami's power.
timeline.quote: In the end, it was the kirin who answered that call.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The orochi accept the kami's terms without hesitation, and the kami grant them greater power and a new form.
timeline.quote: Touched by their devotion, the kami granted the Orochi power magnitudes greater than what they had ever had before

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
